_comment: https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/10069 - two entries reach the same external through the same eliminated re-export shim, and a third only imports a name from it. Each cjs chunk emits its own `require`, so each decides the interop wrapper on its own. `named-user` wrapping too is expected: the recorded interop is per-bundle, so a default import in one chunk wraps the external in all of them (see `recorded_external_interop`, which records what that costs — the wrapper is value-transparent for named access, which `_test.mjs` asserts, but not identity- or descriptor-transparent).
